outputFull.title: Can't add more assets.
outputFull.text: This transaction output can't hold any more assets. Just create a new output (you can use the same address) to add more.

couldNotAddAllPaymentRequestAssets.title: Can’t complete this request
couldNotAddAllPaymentRequestAssets.text: Your account doesn’t include every asset in this payment request. If all assets are required, don’t continue. Add the missing assets or use another account.

datum.label: Datum
datum.caption: Add inline datum or hash of datum to output.

input.placeholder: Inline datum JSON / CBOR, or hash

datum.inline: Inline datum is attached to the output.

error.title: Invalid inline datum JSON / CBOR, or hash

refscript.label: Reference script
refscript.caption: Add a plutus or native (multi-sig) reference script to output.
refscript.plutus: Plutus script is attached to the output.
refscript.native: Native script is attached to the output.

plutusV1.label: Plutus V1
plutusV1.caption: Plutus V1 is the initial ledger language version, which introduced the Alonzo era.

plutusV2.label: Plutus V2
plutusV2.caption: Plutus V2 was enabled at the Vasil hard fork, which introduced the Babbage era.

plutusV3.label: Plutus V3
plutusV3.caption: Plutus V3 was enabled at the Chang hard fork, which introduced the Conway era.

multisig.label: Native Script
multisig.caption: A native script or multi-sig, is a set of rules that defines how you can spend a UTxO.

action.invalid: Output not complete, please add address and funds to send first.

error.addAddress: Add a recipient address to send to.
